summary: Physician, lawyer and author of the standard History of Long Island; John's 3rd cousin 8x removed.
bio:
Benjamin Franklin Thompson was born on 15 May 1784, the son of Dr. Samuel Thompson and his first wife Phebe Satterly. He descends from John Thompson through Samuel, Jonathan and Dr. Samuel, making him John's 3rd cousin eight times removed; he is probably also a 4th cousin eight times removed through the Topping family, since his grandmother Mary Woodhull, born in 1711, appears to have been a granddaughter of Temperance Topping. He married on 12 June 1810.

A physician and lawyer, he wrote the History of Long Island, published in 1839 and 1843, which became the standard work on the island; in it he called John Thompson 'the first Long Island ancestor of the compiler'. There is an irony in his own account of the family: it contains two errors later disproved, a birth year of 1609 for John Thompson and a Mayflower Brewster wife for him. He died in 1849.
sources: [R4-S1] B. F. Thompson, History of Long Island, 3rd ed. (1918), vol. 3 (archive.org full text), pp. 297-298 (secondary) https://archive.org/details/historyoflongisl003thom
